raw: Made order search fast enough that support stopped seeing timeouts

probe.problem: Order search on the internal support dashboard timed out under load; support agents waited seconds for every lookup.
probe.action: Designed and built a composite index plus a keyset-paginated query, replaced the ORM-generated search, and added a load test to CI.
probe.result: p95 latency fell from 1200 ms to 450 ms on the production replica, and timeouts disappeared from the dashboard logs.
probe.scope: One service, the support dashboard, 40 support agents
probe.my_role: Owned the fix end to end: profiling, design, rollout
